name: Mia Smith
source:
The protagonist's roommate, she has had a crush on him for awhile. He assumes that she is not only out of his league but also thinks of him as a brother. No matter how she tempts him, he holds off and she is unsuccessful.

When she hears that the protagonist is dating another woman, she decides to stop tempting him and outright state her intentions.
